name: Komae Nana
source:
Takuma's cousin. One day she has a sudden physical development, and now, even if she is in elementary school, she has the body of a very gifted young lady. She is in love with her cousin for years. She has a complex about the size of her breasts. She calls Takuma "onii-chan".

She is the reincarnation of the loyal dog, Hachikō.
